summary:
No action over the last 7 or 14 days across every rating — the model hasn't logged a graded pick since early November, so every "last 14" cell reads 0-0 and the hot/cold flags are empty today. That leaves us leaning entirely on season-long shape and the 30-day window, where R1 through R4 all went a clean 2-1 over their last three strong plays, with R4 the standout at 64% (119-68, +63.0u) on the year and a 3W streak intact in the SP category across all four ratings. The flip side is bullpen_fatigue, which is bleeding a 4-game losing streak across R1-R3 and sitting at just 47% (520-598) for the season — avoid letting that category swing any close calls today, no matter how loud the model's overall number looks.

On the board, the categories to trust are the combo plays: trends+sp is the best agreement pair at 58% (370-268, n=638), with trends+runs right behind at 57.3%. Any game where SP and trends both point the same direction should carry more weight than a single-category signal, especially since SP is the one category riding a live 3W streak across every rating tier. Team-wise, if MIL, TBR, BOS, or LAD show up as the model's pick today, lean in hard — all four are running 69%+ win rates when picked, and BOS/LAD strong plays are hitting at 76% and 80% with +19u and +27u respectively. NYY is the one name to fade on sight: 49% overall and a losing strong-play record (9-14, -4.0u), the only team on the list bleeding units when the model says "strong." With no fresh 14-day signal to lean on, today's edge comes from stacking trends+sp agreement with a rostered favorite like LAD or BOS — that's where the model's season-long strength and today's category convergence actually overlap.
